description: Source code for a Raspberry Pi launcher implementation of the Starboard abstraction, managing remote execution, process control, and communication via pexpect.

classes.name: Launcher
classes.description: A class for launching and managing tests on a Raspberry Pi device, including remote process control, command execution, and cleanup.

methods.name: _GetAndCheckTestFile
methods.description: Checks for the existence of a test file in the expected directory.

methods.name: _GetAndCheckTestFileWithFallback
methods.description: Attempts to get the test file with a '_loader' suffix, falls back to target name.

methods.name: _InitPexpectCommands
methods.description: Initializes rsync and ssh commands, and test command setup.

methods.name: _ShutdownBackoff
methods.description: Checks if shutdown has been initiated, with delay.

methods.name: _PexpectSpawnAndConnect
methods.description: Spawns a pexpect process to connect to the device.

methods.name: _PexpectSendLine
methods.description: Sends a command line to the pexpect process.

methods.name: _PexpectReadLines
methods.description: Reads lines from the pexpect process, detects test completion.

methods.name: _Sleep
methods.description: Sends sleep command and waits for completion.

methods.name: _WaitForPrompt
methods.description: Waits until the device prompt appears.

methods.name: _KillExistingCobaltProcesses
methods.description: Kills leftover cobalt processes on the device.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main method to run tests on the device, managing setup, execution, and cleanup.

methods.name: Kill
methods.description: Stops the launcher and aborts ongoing processes.

methods.name: GetDeviceOutputPath
methods.description: Returns the path for test output files.
